Miami garlic prawns.make_ahead: Butterfly the prawns and slice the garlic up to 1 day ahead, chilled; cook and make the pan sauce on the night

steps.text: Butterfly the prawns.
Heat the olive oil until very hot, add the prawns with garlic and chilli and cook.
Add the stock and lemon juice, bubble for a minute, then swirl in the butter and parsley.
Serve in the pan with crusty bread for the juices.

Shoes-on teriyaki steak.make_ahead: Make the apple juice glaze up to 3 days ahead, chilled; cook the rice and sear the steaks on the night

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice, rice vinegar and sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Cook the rice.
Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, brushing with glaze in the last minute.
Rest for 5 minutes, slice, and blanch the bok choy to serve alongside.

Social club Rob Roy.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags and cloves in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then lift them out.
Chill the smoky tea in the fridge and put four heavy tumblers in the freezer for 15 minutes.
Stir 200ml of the tea with the grape juice, balsamic and demerara syrup over ice in a jug for 30 seconds.
Strain over a large ice cube in each tumbler, twist orange peel over and drop it in, and add a cherry.

Skyfall lodge venison.make_ahead: Mash the swede up to 1 day ahead and reheat; rub the venison with its spices up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge, then sear on the night

steps.text: Roast the potatoes with the oil at 200C until golden and crisp.
Boil the swede until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Rub the venison with juniper, thyme, salt and pepper. Sear in a hot pan until browned all over, then rest.
Add the stock, redcurrant jelly and balsamic to the pan and reduce to a glossy sauce.
Slice the venison and serve with the mash, potatoes and sauce.
Toast the oats in a dry pan until nutty, then cool.
Whip the cream with the honey and vanilla to soft peaks.
Lightly crush the raspberries.
Layer cream, raspberries and oats in four glasses, finishing with oats on top.

Silva's island Scotch penicillin.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain.
While the syrup cools, steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill the tea.
Shake 200ml of the smoky tea with the lemon juice and honey ginger syrup over ice, in batches, and strain over a large ice cube in each tumbler.
Float the last of the tea on top over the back of a spoon and garnish with candied ginger.

San Francisco cioppino.make_ahead: Make the tomato, fennel and verjuice base up to 2 days ahead and chill; add the seafood on the night

steps.text: Slice the fennel and onion and crush the garlic.
Soften in oil.
Add the tomatoes, verjuice and stock and simmer.
Add the crab, then the clams and mussels, then the prawns and fish, cooking until the shells open.
Serve with sliced sourdough.

Torchy's bourbon boilermaker.make_ahead: Steep and chill the tea and lagers up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; pour the tea shots to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and stir in the maple syrup and vanilla.
Chill the lagers and the tea until icy.
Pour the tea into shot glasses.
Twist a small strip of orange peel over each and serve with a cold alcohol-free lager.
Mash the ripe camembert with a fork until mostly smooth.
Beat in the soft butter, the cream cheese, the sweet paprika, a little caraway seeds, half a very finely diced red onion and the alcohol-free beer.
Season with salt and pepper and chill 30 minutes.
Spread on the slices of dark rye and top with thin red onion rings, chives and a dusting of paprika.

Das Boot lemon radler.make_ahead: Lemon syrup up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and the zest of three lemons for 3 minutes, then add their juice and chill.
Mix the syrup with the cold soda water.
Pour the cold alcohol-free beer into each of the steins and top with the lemon soda.
Add a wheel cut from the last lemon.

Milwaukee beer-battered cheese curds.make_ahead: Make the ranch up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; whisk the batter and fry the cheese on the night

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into cubes and pat dry.
Whisk the flour, egg and alcohol-free beer into a batter.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chopped dill and chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for ranch.
Heat the oil to 185C.
Dip the cheese in batter and fry in batches until golden.
Drain and salt lightly.

Bridal party grapefruit rosé spritz.make_ahead: Chill the juices and soda up to 1 day ahead and slice the strawberries up to 4 hours ahead; build the glasses to order

steps.text: Slice the strawberries and lightly crush a few slices in each of four large wine glasses to turn it pink, then fill with ice and the rest of the strawberries.
Add grape juice and grapefruit juice to each and top with soda water.
Stir gently and finish with a sprig of mint.

Erick's lamb with caramelised potatoes.make_ahead: Roast the lamb up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge with its juices; reheat gently and finish the potatoes, gravy and peas on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C.
Rub the lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, thyme and the crushed garlic cloves and roast covered for 3 hours, uncovering for the last 30 minutes.
Boil the baby potatoes until tender and peel.
Melt the sugar in a pan until golden, add most of the butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed.
Make gravy from the pan juices, the flour, the stock and the balsamic.
Cook the peas, toss with the last of the butter and serve.

Edinburgh after-party fizz.make_ahead: Chill the alcohol-free sparkling wine and the flutes up to 1 day ahead; pour just before the film starts

steps.text: Pour 15ml of elderflower cordial into each of four chilled flutes.
Top each with chilled alcohol-free sparkling wine and a splash of soda water, stirring once.
Make it just before the film starts and keep the bottles cold.

Beef stroganoff.make_ahead: Slice the beef, mushrooms and onion up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; cook the sauce and noodles on the night

steps.text: Slice the beef, mushrooms and onion.
Sear the beef fast and set aside.
Cook the mushrooms and onion in most of the butter, add the paprika and Worcestershire and scrape up the pan.
Add the stock and simmer.
Cook the noodles and toss them with the rest of the butter.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the beef.

Vodka martini.make_ahead: Blitz and strain the cucumber water up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake to order

steps.text: Chill four martini glasses. Blitz the cucumber with the water and strain through a fine sieve.
Shake the cucumber water, verjuice and salt hard with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into the chilled glasses and twist lemon peel over the top.

Venice Beach crispy fish tacos.make_ahead: Pickle the onion, shred the cabbage and mix the chipotle mayo up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; whisk the batter and fry the fish fresh on the night

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle in adobo.
Whisk the flour, the baking powder and the cold alcohol-free beer.
Heat the oil, cut the white fish into strips, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, onion, mayo and coriander.

Slappin' da bass grapefruit paloma.make_ahead: Squeeze the grapefruit and limes and slice the jalapeno up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; build each glass and top with soda water on the night

steps.text: Rub the rims of the tall glasses with lime and dip in salt.
Fill with ice.
Juice two of the grapefruit and the limes. To each glass add the grapefruit juice, lime juice, agave syrup and a slice of jalapeño and stir.
Top with the soda water and add a wedge of the last grapefruit.

Leopold's rooftop dinner.make_ahead: Prep the lemons, fennel and shallot up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast the fish and whisk the verjuice sauce fresh

steps.text: Score the snapper on both sides, season with salt and stuff with the lemon slices, sliced fennel and dill.
Roast the fish at 220C for 25 minutes.
While the fish roasts, boil the new potatoes in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes, then drain.
Reduce the shallot with the verjuice and vinegar until about 2 tbsp is left.
Take off the heat and whisk in the cold butter cube by cube until thick and glossy.
Serve the fish with the potatoes and the sauce.

Leopold's claret cup.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled before adding ice

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and cool.
Mix the grape juice, tea, orange juice and sugar in a jug with the sliced orange and cucumber.
Chill.
Add ice and top with soda water.

Chef Didier's duck with orange sauce.n: Chef Didier's duck with orange sauce

steps.text: Score the duck skin and season. Par-boil the potatoes.
Place the duck skin-side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat to render the fat.
Flip and roast at 200C for 6 minutes, then rest.
Fry the potatoes in some of the duck fat until crisp.
Pour off the rest of the fat, add the zest and juice of the oranges, honey, vinegar and stock and reduce until glossy, then whisk in the butter.
Steam the green beans and serve alongside.
Place a sugar cube in each flute and soak it with a few drops of vanilla and a squeeze of orange juice.
Slowly top with the chilled sparkling apple juice.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.

Chicken scaloppine.make_ahead: Pound the chicken up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; sear and make the stock and lemon sauce just before serving

steps.text: Slice the chicken in half horizontally and pound thin.
Dust in flour and sear in the oil and butter for 2 minutes a side, then set aside.
Add the stock, lemon juice and capers, reduce by half and swirl in the cold butter and parsley.
Return the chicken to coat.

Brooklyn amaretto sours.make_ahead: Mix the orgeat, almond extract, water and lemon juice up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add the egg white and shake to order

steps.text: Shake the orgeat, almond extract, water, lemon juice and egg white hard without ice, in rounds for two drinks at a time.
Shake again with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in four short glasses and add a cherry to each.

Steamed guava duff pudding.make_ahead: Steam the pudding up to 1 day ahead, cool and keep chilled; steam again for 15 minutes and beat the sauce on the day

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, add the sugar and milk to make a soft dough.
Roll out, spread with guava paste and roll up.
Wrap in buttered foil and steam.
Beat the softened butter, icing sugar, orange juice and vanilla together for the sauce.
Slice and serve with the sauce.

Jack's rum, ginger and lime highball.n: Jack's rum, ginger and lime highball (alcohol-free)
Jack's rum, ginger and lime highball.make_ahead: Steep, sweeten and chill the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build the drinks over ice to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags and cinnamon in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out, stir in the sugar and vanilla and chill.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each and drop in the wedge.
Pour in the ginger beer, then float the spiced tea over the top.
Add a slice of ginger and a stirrer.
Brown the chicken and bacon.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the stock, grape juice and balsamic and enough water to cover.
Simmer until rich and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the chicken.

Broadway opening night raspberry fizz.make_ahead: Puree up to 1 day, top just before serving

steps.text: Blend the puree raspberries with the sugar and lemon juice, then push through a sieve.
Spoon a little puree into each chilled flute.
Slowly top with chilled sparkling white grape juice and drop in two raspberries.
Brown the beef in batches.
Add the onions and soften, then pour in the stock, stir in the coffee and add enough water to cover.
Add the thyme, cover and simmer gently until tender.
Boil the potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.

Iceberg Lounge espresso martini.make_ahead: Brew the coffee up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; shake to order so the foam is thick

steps.text: Brew the coffee and cool, and chill the martini glasses.
For each drink, measure 60ml strong coffee, 15ml sugar syrup and a few drops of vanilla into a shaker.
Shake each drink very hard with ice for 15 seconds to build a thick foam.
Strain into a glass and float three coffee beans on top.
Soften the shallot in a little butter, then sear the livers until just pink.
Add the apple juice and let it bubble away.
Blitz the livers, shallot and thyme with soft butter until smooth, then pack into a dish.
Pour melted butter over the top and chill until set.
Serve with cornichons and warm baguette.

Marseille mauresque.make_ahead: Anise tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Pour the boiling water over the star anise and fennel seeds, steep for 10 minutes and strain.
Chill the anise tea until cold.
Put anise tea and orgeat in each of 4 tall glasses, add ice, then pour in chilled water slowly so the orgeat clouds it. Stir once and serve a jug of cold water on the side.
Heat the oven to 200C. Season the beef with salt and pepper and roast until 52C in the middle.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.
Toss the carrots and parsnips with honey and roast.
Reduce the stock and balsamic with the pan juices for gravy.

Green Dragon honey and ginger ale cup.n: Green Dragon honey and ginger ale cup (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Put some syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 pint glasses with ice.
Pour in the alcohol-free ale, tilting the glass.
Stir once and add a lemon wheel.

Anniversary salmon with beurre blanc.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; crush, cook the salmon and whisk the sauce on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt.
Season the salmon and roast skin side down on an oiled tray for 8 minutes.
Simmer the shallot in the verjuice and vinegar until a couple of tablespoons are left. Whisk in the cold butter a piece at a time over low heat.
Blanch the asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the fish.

Philly winter hot spiced apple cider.n: Philly winter hot spiced apple cider (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Put the apple juice, two of the cinnamon sticks, cloves, star anise, half the orange slices and the sugar in a pot.
Bring to a simmer, then hold just below a simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the vanilla, strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick and orange slice to each.
Fry the potato chips in the oil at 140C until soft and drain.
Whisk the flour with the cold alcohol-free beer to a thin batter.
Dip the flathead fillets in the dusting flour, then batter, and fry at 180C.
Fry the chips again until crisp.
Wrap it all in paper with lemon and tartare.

Ten-grand Bondi passionfruit shandy.make_ahead: Stir the passionfruit, lime and sugar base up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add the soda and alcohol-free beer on the night

ingredients.item: passionfruit, pulp, for the soda mix

steps.text: Stir the passionfruit pulp, lime juice and sugar until dissolved.
Add the soda water.
Pour the alcohol-free beer into 4 chilled schooner glasses.
Top with the passionfruit soda and float half a passionfruit on top.

Bernie's beach house clambake.make_ahead: Scrub the clams and prep the corn and garlic up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; cook it all on the night

steps.text: Halve the corn, crush the garlic and scrub the clams.
Boil the potatoes in a big pot.
Add the corn, stock, the juice of the lemon, garlic and butter, then the clams and lobster tails. Cover and steam.
Tip it all onto the table.

Larry and Richard's mai tai.make_ahead: Steep and chill the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; juice the limes and shake each batch to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out, stir in the sugar and vanilla and chill.
Juice the limes.
Shake the spiced tea, orange juice, orgeat and lime juice with ice, in batches.
Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig.

Club cosmopolitan.make_ahead: Juice the limes and mix the juices up to 1 day ahead in a jug in the fridge; shake with ice to order

steps.text: Shake the cranberry juice, orange juice and lime juice hard with ice for each glass.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

Dr. Sobel's calming Negroni.make_ahead: Mix the non-alcoholic gin, aperitif, grape juice and balsamic up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; stir over ice to serve

steps.text: For each drink, stir equal parts non-alcoholic gin, aperitif and grape juice with a drop of balsamic over ice for 20 seconds.
Strain over a big ice cube in a tumbler and add a slice of orange.

Harbour passionfruit fizz.make_ahead: Chill the flutes and the alcohol-free sparkling wine up to 1 day ahead; build the glasses to serve

ingredients.item: bottle alcohol-free sparkling wine (750 ml), chilled

steps.text: Chill the flutes and the alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Spoon passionfruit pulp into each glass with a measure of elderflower cordial.
Top slowly with the alcohol-free sparkling wine, stirring once to lift the pulp. Finish with mint.

Lake house juice pop slushies.make_ahead: Freeze the cubes the night before

steps.text: Freeze the orange juice in ice cube trays overnight.
Blend the juice cubes with the mango, passionfruit, apple juice and honey until slushy.
Pour into tall cups with a straw.

LexCorp gala pear and ginger fizz.n: LexCorp gala pear and ginger fizz
LexCorp gala pear and ginger fizz.make_ahead: Make the ginger syrup up to 1 week ahead and keep it chilled; chill the flutes and top with alcohol-free sparkling wine to order

steps.text: Slice the ginger and simmer with the sugar and water, then strain and cool.
Chill four flutes. Juice the lemon.
Pour pear nectar, ginger syrup and lemon juice into each flute.
Top with alcohol-free sparkling wine and stir once gently.
Thread candied ginger onto picks and rest across each glass.

Egg Shen's plum wine sour.make_ahead: Make the ginger syrup up to 1 week ahead and the plum juice up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; shake to order

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Blitz the plums with the chilled water and push through a sieve.
Shake the plum juice, rice vinegar, lemon juice, ginger syrup and egg white hard without ice, then with ice.
Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and garnish with a pickled plum.

Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar.n: Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar (alcohol-free)
Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar.make_ahead: Chill the juices and flutes up to 1 day ahead; build each glass at the last minute so the fizz stays lively

steps.text: Drop a sugar cube into each of 4 flutes and wet each with a few drops of vanilla.
Add orange juice to each glass.
Top slowly with the sparkling white grape juice.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.

El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch.n: El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and cinnamon for 3 minutes, then cool.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill.
In a jug, stir 180ml of the tea, the pineapple juice, lime juice, 40ml of the syrup and the vanilla.
Pour over ice into four tall glasses, grate nutmeg on top and garnish with a lime wheel.

Cyrus the Virus bourbon smash.make_ahead: Brew and chill the vanilla tea up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; muddle and shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out, stir in the vanilla and chill.
Muddle the lemon wedges with the mint leaves and syrup in a shaker.
Add 200ml of the tea and ice and shake.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice.
Slap a big sprig of mint between your hands and set on top.

Blood orange mezcal margarita.make_ahead: Steep and chill the smoky tea up to 2 days ahead; juice the fruit, salt the rims and shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill the smoky tea.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer.
Wet the rims of four glasses with lime and dip them in the salt.
Juice the blood oranges and limes, keeping back a few orange wheels.
Shake 120ml of the tea, the juices and agave hard over ice for 15 seconds, in two batches if needed.
Strain over fresh ice and garnish each glass with an orange wheel.

Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt.n: Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt (alcohol-free)
Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt.make_ahead: Rim the glasses up to 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Mix the salt, chilli powder and lime zest on a plate. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 chilled glasses and dip in the chilli salt.
Squeeze lime juice into each glass, add ice, then pour in the cold alcohol-free lager slowly.

Brain's bathtub moonshine sour.make_ahead: Mix the base up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 3 minutes, lift them out and chill.
Juice the lemons and stir the sugar into the juice with the warm water.
Shake the tea with the lemon mix and ice, then strain into 4 ice-filled jam jars.

Lou's Tavern boilermaker.make_ahead: Steep and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; chill the cans and freeze the glasses on the day, then pour to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and stir in the maple syrup and vanilla.
Chill the cans, the tea and the pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Pour the alcohol-free lager into the frosted glasses and the tea into shot glasses.
Drink the shot and chase it with the lager, or drop the shot glass carefully into the lager.
Serve with a bowl of salted peanuts.

King's cucumber jalapeño margarita.make_ahead: Blitz and strain the cucumber juice up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; shake each drink to order

steps.text: Blitz most of the continental cucumber with the water and strain.
Rim the glasses with lime and salt.
For each drink, muddle slices of jalapeño in a shaker, add the cucumber juice, lime juice and agave, shake with ice, strain over fresh ice and top with a splash of soda water.
Garnish with a ribbon cut from the last of the cucumber.

Rita's sweet vermouth on the rocks.n: Rita's sweet vermouth on the rocks (alcohol-free)
Rita's sweet vermouth on the rocks.make_ahead: Steep and chill the clove tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and freeze the ice blocks up to 1 week ahead; mix and pour on the night

steps.text: Steep the tea bag and cloves in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill.
Mix 100ml of the tea with the grape juice and balsamic.
Put a large ice block in each rocks glass and pour over the mix.
Peel long strips of orange zest, twist over the glass, rub round the rim and drop in. Stir twice.

Lamb and stout stew over mash.n: Lamb and stout stew over mash
Lamb and stout stew over mash.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the onions and carrots.
Brown the lamb in batches in the oil.
Add the onions, carrots, stock, coffee and water.
Simmer until tender.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
Serve over the mash with crusty bread on the side.

Greater good steak and ale pie.n: Greater good steak and ale pie

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a little of the oil and soften the sliced onions.
Add thyme, alcohol-free beer and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and braise gently until the beef is tender.
Thicken the sauce with the flour mixed to a paste, simmer, then tip into a pie dish and cool slightly.
Top with puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cut the potatoes into chips, fry in the oil until golden, and boil the peas. Serve alongside.
Warm half the pomegranate juice with the sugar, cinnamon and cloves until the sugar dissolves, then cool.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then lift them out.
Pour into a jug with the grape juice, the rest of the pomegranate juice and the orange slices.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Pour over ice into cups and scatter pomegranate seeds on top.

Amity sailing day rum punch.make_ahead: Jug up to 4 hours ahead, add the soda water just before serving

steps.text: Stir the juices, grenadine and vanilla in a large jug.
Chill for an hour.
Top the jug with the soda water and stir once.
Fill tall glasses with ice, pour in the punch and finish with grated nutmeg, a pineapple wedge and a cherry.

Maple bourbon coffee with whipped cream.n: Maple bourbon coffee with whipped cream (alcohol-free)
Maple bourbon coffee with whipped cream.make_ahead: Whip the cream with a little maple syrup up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; brew and pour the coffee to order

steps.text: Brew the strong coffee.
Whip the cream with a little of the maple syrup to soft peaks.
Into each of the big mugs pour the rest of the maple syrup and a few drops of vanilla, then the hot coffee and stir.
Spoon the cream on top so it floats and grate over a little nutmeg.

Uncle Benny's lychee ginger highball.make_ahead: Drain the lychees and slice the ginger up to 1 day ahead, chilled; build over ice with the non-alcoholic gin to order

steps.text: Drain the lychees, keeping the syrup.
Fill glasses with ice, add the non-alcoholic gin, some lychee syrup and a squeeze of lime to each.
Top with ginger ale and stir once.
Thread a lychee onto a cocktail pick with a thin slice of ginger and lay it across each glass.

Manhattan cocktail.make_ahead: Steep and chill the tea with the cloves, maple syrup and vanilla up to 3 days ahead in a covered jar in the fridge. Stir with the grape juice and balsamic over ice to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags and cloves in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and stir in the maple syrup and vanilla.
Chill the tea and four coupes for 15 minutes.
Stir 240ml of the tea with the grape juice and balsamic over plenty of ice, one or two at a time.
Strain into the coupes, squeeze a strip of orange peel over each and discard it, and drop in a cherry.

Money Train payday michelada.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt up to 1 week ahead; stir the tomato juice, lime and sauces together up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and add the alcohol-free lager to serve

ingredients.item: limes, juiced, with some cut into wedges

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Rub a lime wedge around each of 4 glass rims and dip in the chilli salt.
Add ice, a good squeeze of lime juice, the tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire, dividing evenly.
Top each with a cold alcohol-free lager, stir gently and slip the glasses into small paper bags.

Delta Psi tropical rum punch.make_ahead: Mix and chill the pineapple juice, passionfruit, lime juice and coconut water up to 1 day ahead; add the lemonade, orange, ice and mint just before serving

steps.text: Mix the pineapple juice, passionfruit pulp, lime juice and coconut water in a big jug or bowl.
Chill.
Just before serving, add the lemonade, orange slices and plenty of ice. Stir gently and scatter with mint.

Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups.n: Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups (alcohol-free)
Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill.
Shake 120ml of the tea, the lemon juice, 40ml of the syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into four china teacups, dot the foam with drops of pomegranate molasses and serve straight away.
Rub a lime wedge around the rims of tall glasses and dip in sea salt.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Add grapefruit juice, lime juice and agave to each glass and stir.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

Conner4Real cucumber gin spritz.make_ahead: Muddle the cucumber, mint, lime juice and syrup and stir in the non-alcoholic gin up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; strain over ice and top with sparkling water to serve

steps.text: Muddle some cucumber slices with the mint, juice of two limes and sugar syrup in a jug. Add the non-alcoholic gin and stir.
Fill wine glasses with ice and the remaining cucumber.
Strain the mix into the glasses and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.

Wheels-up bourbon smash.make_ahead: Steep, flavour and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; muddle and shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out, stir in the vanilla and chill.
Muddle the mint leaves and lemon wedges with the syrup in a shaker.
Add 180ml of the tea and ice and shake hard.
Double strain into 4 glasses filled with crushed ice.
Top with a sprig of mint and serve with short straws.

Rooney wake Irish coffee.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whip the cream to soft ribbons so it just holds its shape. Brew the coffee.
Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out.
Add brown sugar, a few drops of vanilla and coffee to each glass and stir until dissolved.
Float the cream on top over the back of a spoon. Do not stir.

Key West rum punch.make_ahead: Mix the coconut water, juices, grenadine and vanilla in a jug up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; pour over ice and grate the nutmeg to serve

steps.text: Fill four glasses with ice.
Add coconut water, pineapple juice, orange juice, lime juice, grenadine and a drop of vanilla to each.
Stir and finish with a light grating of nutmeg.

Manhattan bistro steak.make_ahead: Fry the frites the first time up to 3 hours ahead and leave on a tray; fry again, cook the steaks and make the Worcestershire sauce on the night

ingredients.item: neutral oil, for searing the steaks

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in 140C oil until cooked but pale, drain and cool.
While the frites cool, season the steaks.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Sear the steaks in a heavy hot pan with oil on both sides.
Lower the heat, add the butter and thyme and baste briefly, then rest the steaks.
Add the peppercorns and Worcestershire to the pan, then the stock and reduce. Stir in the cream and simmer. Serve with the steaks and frites.

Mustache's chamomile whisky toddy.make_ahead: Steep both teas with the honey, vanilla and lemon up to 1 day ahead, chilled; reheat and pour into mugs

steps.text: Steep the chamomile and black tea bags in the water for 5 minutes, then remove.
Stir in the honey, vanilla and the juice of one lemon.
Pour into mugs. Finish with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with cloves.

Rayna Boyanov's high roller spritz.make_ahead: Best built in the glass; cut the orange wedges up to 1 day ahead and chill the sparkling wine and aperitif

steps.text: Fill large wine glasses with ice.
Pour the aperitif into each, then add the alcohol-free sparkling wine and soda water. Stir gently once.
Slide a thick wedge of blood orange into each glass and serve with a bowl of olives.

EM-50 Urban Assault Irish coffee.make_ahead: Lightly whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead and keep chilled; warm the glasses and brew the coffee just before serving

steps.text: Warm heatproof glasses with hot water, then tip it out.
Stir the sugar and a few drops of vanilla into each glass, then fill with hot coffee to near the top.
Lightly whip the cream until it just thickens but still pours.
Pour the cream slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.

Asgardian honey ginger beer or mead.n: Asgardian honey ginger beer or mead (alcohol-free)
Asgardian honey ginger beer or mead.make_ahead: Best built in the glass just before serving; keep the ginger beer well chilled

steps.text: Stir a spoon of honey, a squeeze of lemon and a slice of ginger into each of four glasses until the honey dissolves.
Fill with ice and top with ginger beer.
Stir once and raise the glasses high.

Holy water gin and elderflower fizz.n: Holy water gin and elderflower fizz (alcohol-free)
Holy water gin and elderflower fizz.make_ahead: Mix the non-alcoholic gin, cordial and lemon juice in a jar up to 1 day ahead and keep it in the fridge; shake with ice and top with soda to serve

steps.text: Shake the non-alcoholic gin, cordial and lemon juice hard with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into tall glasses over fresh ice and top with soda water.
Add a mint sprig and a lemon wheel.

Rooftop herbal liqueur ginger fizz.make_ahead: Herbal tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bag, star anise, cinnamon and cloves in the boiling water with the honey for 10 minutes, then strain.
Put the herbal tea in the freezer until icy cold.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add the herbal tea and lime juice to each, then top with cold ginger beer.
Stir once, add an orange slice and toast on the roof.

Light horse camp beef and stout stew.n: Light horse camp beef and stout stew
Light horse camp beef and stout stew.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the chuck, onions and carrots and toss the beef in flour.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the onions, carrots and garlic and cook.
Add the tomato paste, stock, coffee, thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is tender.
Peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

Hotel bar martini.make_ahead: Freeze the glasses up to 1 day ahead and mix the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice in a jug in the fridge; stir over ice to serve

steps.text: Freeze the martini glasses.
Stir the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice over ice in batches, then strain into the glasses.
Garnish each with an olive.

Gold Room bourbon old fashioned.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and chill the smoky tea.
For each drink, measure 60ml tea, 10ml demerara sugar syrup and a drop of vanilla into a mixing glass.
Stir each drink with ice in a mixing glass for 20 seconds.
Strain into a rocks glass over one large ice block.
Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.

Warm sake with yuzu and ginger.n: Warm sake with yuzu and ginger (alcohol-free)
Warm sake with yuzu and ginger.make_ahead: Steep the tea with the ginger up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and reheat gently; stir in the yuzu and honey to serve

steps.text: Heat the water until just steaming, about 80C, never boiling, and pour over the tea bags and ginger in a heatproof jug.
Steep for 3 minutes, then lift out the tea bags.
Stir in the yuzu and honey and pour into small cups.

Red Guardian cherry tea punch.make_ahead: Steep, sweeten and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; add the lemon juice, then top with soda and ice to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags for 5 minutes, remove them and stir in the jam.
Chill well, then strain out any fruit.
Mix with the juice of half the lemon.
Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the tea, top with soda water and garnish with a lemon slice and cherries.
Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes.
Brown the beef in oil.
Add the onions, carrots, stock, coffee and water to cover and simmer.
Add the potatoes and simmer until thick.
Serve in bowls with crusty bread.

USS Missouri navy grog.make_ahead: Steep and chill the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; make the honey syrup and shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out, stir in the vanilla and chill.
Dissolve the honey in the hot water.
Shake 180ml of the tea, the lime juice, grapefruit juice and the honey syrup with ice.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice.
Add a lime wheel to each and grate a little nutmeg on top.

Tess's Manhattan cocktail.make_ahead: Steep and chill the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir with the grape juice and balsamic over ice and strain to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags and cloves in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and stir in the maple syrup and vanilla.
Chill the tea and four coupes for 15 minutes.
Stir 240ml of the tea with the grape juice and balsamic over ice.
Strain into the chilled coupes and drop a cherry in each.

Mugatu's vodka pasta.make_ahead: Fry the garlic, chilli and tomato paste up to 1 day ahead and chill; add the lemon juice and cream and toss with freshly cooked pasta on the night

steps.text: Cook the rigatoni 2 minutes short of done, keeping a cup of the cooking water.
Saute the garlic and chilli in the butter.
Fry the tomato paste until brick red.
Add the lemon juice and a splash of the pasta water, then the cream.
Toss the pasta through the sauce with the parmesan and basil.
